title: Implement authorized Agent Runtime decision and MessageEnvelope core
verify: Provider request snapshots prove one closed ProviderRequestV1 with only schema_version, project-owned agent_definition, ordered records, and matching ordered source_refs; ActorContext, account/membership/role/grant/session provenance, provider selection, credentials, and arbitrary metadata are absent.

Production assembler tests prove exact AgentInputRecordV1 `{record_type, source_ref, payload}` variants and the canonical Plant, latest completed check-in, latest pH, latest EC order; one row latest for both measurements appears once in the pH position and at most four PostgreSQL records are sent.

Plant Operations service/API tests prove normalized observation lengths 1 and 2000 Unicode code points succeed, 2001 returns 422 OBSERVATION_TEXT_TOO_LONG with no check-in, measurement, or timeline write, and no value is truncated, chunked, or implicitly summarized. A legacy oversized persisted row returns context_denied/input_contract_violation before provider or audit I/O.

Strict tests cover the exact AgentModelResultV1 candidate_claim_type/candidate_output matrix, reject model-owned safety/approval/publication fields, and prove every non-silent MessageEnvelope is immutable pending_classification with consumable_by_agents=false. The classification handoff accepts only `{schema_version,message_id,classifier_version,classification,safe_task_kind,reason_code}` and the canonical safe_information, safe_task_request(check|measurement|follow_up), physical_action, and blocked_uncertain rows; FT-007 creates no Bus/UI/task/Safety effect.

Post-model integration reloads the original LocalSession and exact active Account/Membership/Farm/Plant/grant under the Session Storage, Account/Membership, Session Lifecycle, ActorContext, and Plant Lifecycle contracts. MessageEnvelope authorization_scope contains exactly farm_id, plant_id, current role_preset, operation_kind, permission_source, and nullable grant_id. Timeline actor_ref positively contains only account_id, membership_id, and request-time role_preset and excludes session/auth material.

Tests cover every AgentRuntimeOutcomeV1 row and exact nullable/ref/provider/audit states: envelope_ready, model_silent, context_denied, runtime_not_configured, provider_failed, output_invalid, publication_guard_denied, and audit_failed. No denial/failure becomes status or final_decision silent.

Exactly one canonical sanitized agent_runtime_decided event is appended for each provider-I/O branch and no event exists for context_denied, runtime_not_configured, or audit_failed. Audit failure returns no MessageEnvelope/event ref.

Archive or revoke during an in-flight invocation returns the exact publication_guard_denied branch, creates no MessageEnvelope, Bus/UI/task effect, or replay after restore. Production code adds no public agent endpoint, mutable agent-run/provider-history persistence, fake fallback, Agno memory/tools, or Team behavior.

BHV-001 and BHV-003 trace to named deterministic tests; TASK-029 supplies the credentialed provider portion of BHV-001. The absent Operator UI cap/counter remains explicitly routed to FT-016 and is not claimed by this task.
evidence_required: Plant Operations 1/2000/2001 backend boundary and zero-write evidence
PostgreSQL assembler order/dedup plus legacy oversized-row denial evidence
fresh session/account/membership/Plant/grant recheck and safe Timeline attribution evidence
pending-envelope/classifier handoff evidence with no downstream effect
sanitized timeline payload and audit-failure evidence
focused and full non-real-model regression summaries
purpose: Create the provider-neutral, authorization-sensitive FT-007 runtime core and close the authoritative observation-input delta before adding production model composition or Plant bootstrap wiring.
success_outcome: Authorized contract-valid Plant evidence can pass through the exact provider request, model-result, runtime-outcome, pending MessageEnvelope, current-authorization, classifier-handoff, and Timeline boundaries; oversized observations fail without writes or provider I/O, and no Bus/UI/task effect or fake runtime behavior is introduced.
anti_goals: No provider/model configuration, canonical roster/bootstrap hook, or real-provider dependency in W1.
No public agent HTTP route, BusEventEnvelope, chat/UI Feed persistence, worker, outbox, or FT-008 implementation.
No Operator UI/PWA implementation; its 2000-code-point counter/input behavior remains FT-016 ownership.
No vision photo input, hydroponics policy, Safety Gate effect, task/follow-up, Companion governance, or dataset behavior.
No provider request/response, prompt, reasoning, session, or agent-run persistence.
No production fake, mock, hardcoded, canned, heuristic, or fallback output.

forbidden_scope: Bus, chat, UI Feed, worker, outbox, or FT-008 implementation
Safety classifier policy/effects or FT-011/FT-012 implementation
vision, advisor, safety, task, Companion, or dataset product behavior
unredacted auth, provider, path, or hidden-reasoning evidence
stop_conditions: TASK-025-T3-FT-004-W3 is not done or its canonical Plant-operation pH/EC baseline is contradicted.
Exact ProviderRequestV1 cannot be assembled through existing ActorContext and PostgreSQL authority without accepting caller-built context or sending authorization/session data to the provider.
The fresh post-model guard cannot revalidate the original session/account/membership/Plant/grant identity without exposing auth material.
Correctness would require Bus/UI/task/Safety effects, Operator UI implementation, a new public agent API, or mutable agent-run/provider-history persistence.
Diagnostics or evidence contain credentials, session/auth material, raw provider payload, hidden reasoning, raw chat, unapproved governance content, or local absolute paths.

constraints: Implement the exact ProviderRequestV1, AgentInputRecordV1, AgentModelResultV1, AgentRuntimeOutcomeV1, MessageEnvelope v1, and agent_runtime_decided matrices; reject unknown/incompatible fields without repair.

Build provider input only from authorized PostgreSQL Plant/check-in/measurement rows in canonical order, derive refs internally, and keep all authorization/session/provider-selection data outside ProviderRequestV1.

Enforce the Plant Operations 2000-Unicode-code-point backend cap with OBSERVATION_TEXT_TOO_LONG and zero writes; reject legacy oversized rows as context_denied/input_contract_violation before provider/audit without truncation or summary.
Perform provider execution outside database transactions and reload the original current session/account/membership/Plant/grant authority afterward using the direct identity/session lifecycle inputs.
Return envelope_ready only after strict validation, fresh current authority, and successful sanitized timeline append; keep every envelope pending/non-consumable and implement no classifier effect.
Keep test executors behind explicit test dependency injection and absent from production composition.
invariants: Agno/provider output is never runtime authority; project schemas, authorization, and PostgreSQL records remain authoritative.
ActorContext, account/membership/role/grant/session provenance, credentials, raw chat/UI, provider history, and hidden reasoning never cross the model-input boundary.

Only strict model-declared silence uses status/final_decision silent; invalid, failed, denied, archive/revoke-blocked, and audit-failed branches create no MessageEnvelope or replayable publication candidate.
Timeline is sanitized append-only audit/export and cannot reconstruct or authorize an Agent Runtime decision.
FT-007 envelope_ready is a transient handoff, not Bus/UI publication authority.
verification_targets: Run focused service probes for exact provider payload/order/dedup, observation bounds and legacy-row denial, current authorization recheck, classifier handoff, outcome/event matrices, archive/revoke races, safe audit, and audit failure.
Inspect production composition for test executors, canned output, Bus/UI writes, public routes, and provider/prompt/session persistence.
